change_rule: f → β (when not initial or after stressed syllable)

name: Grassmann's Law (Greek)
environment: when two aspirated consonants in adjacent syllables

name: Grassmann's Law (Sanskrit)
environment: when two aspirated consonants in adjacent syllables

name: Latin to French: Palatalization of /k/ before /a/

Proto-Slavic Second Palatalization
environment: before new front vowels from diphthongs

name: Proto-Slavic Yer Fall
environment: weak yers lost, strong yers vocalized

name: Umlaut in Germanic
change_rule: a → e, u → y, o → ø

name: Old English i-Mutation
change_rule: a → e, o → e, u → y

name: Ingvaeonic Nasal Spirant Law
change_rule: VnC → V̄C (nasal loss with vowel lengthening)

name: Sino-Tibetan Tone Genesis
change_rule: voiced → low tone, voiceless → high tone
